_comment: RVPS reference values for mvhd-trustee on Azure (ADR-069, ADR-073): what the attestation policy (trustee/policies/attestation-ear-cpu.rego, set as default_cpu) compares SEV-SNP evidence from the ACI groups with. Take each REPLACE value from the first attestation (21-aci-confidential-spe.sh --check prints the loader's 'pinnable claims'), check snp_launch_measurement against Microsoft's endorsement of the UVM (reference-info-base64 in the group), save a copy outside the repository with the placeholders replaced, and run 21-aci-confidential-spe.sh --trustee --reference-values <file>. A list is 'one of', a scalar an exact value.
_tcb_comment: The TCB is a floor, not a list (#833): snp_<component>_min is one integer, and any reported value at or above it passes (a higher SVN is newer AMD firmware). The numbers here are the lower of the two hosts the groups landed on (2026-11-02: bootloader 10/12, microcode 84/88, snp 23/28, tee 0); raise one when AMD revokes the firmware below it. A list (snp_bootloader, snp_microcode, snp_snp_svn, snp_tee_svn) still works for a component that has no minimum. The launch measurement and the configuration values stay exact.
